none: PAS WILT-C76093: Possible Early-medieval spindle whorl
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead spindle whorl of possible early medieval date (c. AD 700 - 1100). The spindle whorl is circular with a trapezoidal cross-section. The upper face is slightly convex and is incised with a series of longitudinal grooves, some of which also exhibit diagonal and horizontal branches.
